comparisonMethod.scope: Sequential host measurements after all compiler workers finish; warm local checks only.
comparisonMethod.order: Alternate old/new and new/old within each paired sample.
comparisonMethod.payload: 16 MiB of repeated ariax-size-perf- bytes; SHA-256 checked after every transfer.
comparisonMethod.server: Loopback Python ThreadingHTTPServer with HEAD, Range, stable ETag and Connection: close; HTTPS uses the existing repository test certificate and SSL_CERT_FILE trust anchor.

harnessAdjustments: Linux filesystem tests require POSIX mode bits, unavailable on the artifact NTFS mount. Runtime-only fixtures moved to /run/shm; compiler scratch stayed on artifact storage.
The /dev/shm symlink was correctly rejected by safe-path checks; the physical /run/shm path passed.
Updated the pre-existing xtask synthetic aria2 fixture to include all registry-declared options.
limitations: Paired warm local startup and HTTP/HTTPS throughput samples are bounded regression checks, not full performance or tail-latency acceptance.
No new full workspace matrix, sanitizer, minimum/fresh OS, independent reproducibility or VM power-loss campaign.
No new dependency versions; previous advisory disposition and P7 deferrals remain.
Combined reductions are measured together; the analysis checkpoint separately measured Linux relocation savings.
